Frontend Performance Checklist

Feb 25, 2026

Strong performance comes from repeated small decisions: optimized media, lean CSS, and reduced JavaScript execution.

Prioritize what users see first, lazy-load non-critical assets, and validate improvements with real performance metrics.

A fast experience increases user trust, engagement, and conversion across devices.
